issues.reason: Names and casing restricts the capitalized-common-noun (no Name) default to singular collectives and routes a capitalized plural kind-word label to a Name-only individual — 'one symbol, Name atom, no GroupOf and no per-member kind from the label word' — so the parse emits the barred type atom and omits the mandatory Name fact.

new_gaps: The plural label clause fires on a label 'referring as a name', but that trigger is never operationalized: nothing separates a label whose word is not the members' kind ('the Wrens') from one where it genuinely is ('the Keepers'), and the clause's blanket bar on the kind atom then discards a kind the text arguably states with no slot to record it.

The prepositional-verb oblique licenses (To <event> <NP>) ('referred to the memo'), which is shape-identical to the purpose connective (To <main-event> <purpose-event>) that seeds the PurposeOf bridge — so a non-purposive To oblique like (To sk_time_1 sk_tide_1) can derive a purpose the sentence never states, with nothing in the instruction set distinguishing the two uses.
defect_summary: The compliant form is a name-derived individual keepers carrying (Name keepers "Keepers") as the timing event's Agent, with no (GroupOf sk_keepers_1 keeper) and no keeper type atom taken from the label word.
notes: Everything else is well-grounded: 'time X to Y' takes the preposition-named oblique rather than a spatial Goal, the scheduled-occurrence object correctly takes Patient under the cancel/postpone clause, both compounds get head genus only (noun modifiers unexposed), and the habitual present correctly carries no status atom.
